name: Woman Pastors
overview: Scripture acknowledges women in significant spiritual roles, as seen in Deborah, a prophetess and judge over Israel who led and inspired her people during a critical time (Judges 4:4; 5:7). The Lord empowers many to proclaim His word, indicating a broad company of those who publish His message (Psalms 68:11). While the New Testament highlights Christ’s authority and identity (Matthew 9:6; 16:15; John 6:50), the examples of Deborah demonstrate that God has used women in leadership and prophetic capacities within His redemptive plan.
